How courses are delivered

Three ways to run it

Same curriculum and the same instructors — pick the format that fits your team's calendar and budget.

In-house at your office

We bring the instruments and datasets to you, and teach on your own projects where the data allows. The most effective option for a team working to one standard.

Best for: utilities, municipal teams, contractors

Open enrolment cohorts

Scheduled courses at our training room, with participants from several organisations. Cost-effective for one or two people at a time.

Best for: individuals and small teams

Online & blended

Theory and software modules delivered live online, with an optional field weekend for practical assessment where geography allows.

Best for: distributed teams

What each participant gets

More than a week in a classroom

Courses are assessed, documented and reported back to management, so the investment is visible and the skills are traceable.

  • Printed workbook and exercise set
  • Dataset pack to keep after the course
  • Instruments supplied for field modules
  • Practical and written assessment
  • Certificate of completion with grade
  • 30 days of follow-up support by email
  • Course report to your management
  • Option to align to your CPD framework
Can you train at our office?

Yes. In-house delivery is our most requested format. We travel with total stations, GNSS receivers and levels, and only need a room, power and a site we can work on nearby.

What is the minimum group size?

Six participants for in-house courses, with a maximum of twenty so that everyone gets hands on the instruments. Smaller groups can join an open enrolment cohort.

Do participants need prior experience?

Foundation courses assume none — we start from the instrument and the coordinate system. Intermediate and advanced courses state their prerequisites on the course sheet we send with the proposal.

Is the certificate recognised?

It is a certificate of competence issued by us against the assessment record, and it can be aligned to your institution's CPD or internal training framework. We do not claim accreditation we do not hold.

How far in advance should we book?

Four to six weeks for in-house courses so we can tailor exercises to your data. Open enrolment places can usually be confirmed within a week.
